entities.summary: Peter Famiyeh Bozah, known by the stage name Fameye, is a Ghanaian rapper and musician from Bogoso. He is best known for his single "Nothing I Get". He released a remix of the song which featured Article Wan, Medikal and Kuami Eugene. He was a member of MTN Hitmaker Season 3. Fameye holds the title of hi-life artiste of the year, as awarded at the recently concluded Telecel Ghana music awards. Fameye was a composers & musicians from Bogoso (b. 1994, Bogoso). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
